Collapse

A button that opens and closes a region elsewhere on the page — help under a toolbar, more filters, the details of a row — by the library's own command, --toggle. A closed region is hidden="until-found", so the browser's find in page still reaches its words and opens it. A section that opens under its own header is an accordion.

Examples

The button names its region with commandfor and command="--toggle", and says in aria-expanded whether the region is open: write it as the region starts, and the library keeps it.

A price is per person. Children from four to eleven pay the child price; under four they travel free.

<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="collapse-help-text" command="--toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="collapse-help-text"><i class="bi bi-question-circle" aria-hidden="true"></i>How prices work</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-help-text" hidden="until-found">
	<p class="text-muted">A price is per person. Children from four to eleven pay the child price; under four they travel free.</p>
</div>

Open from the start

A region without hidden starts open, its button aria-expanded="true".

<div class="hstack gap-8">
	<button class="btn btn-sm" type="button" commandfor="collapse-open-filters" command="--toggle" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="collapse-open-filters"><i class="bi bi-funnel" aria-hidden="true"></i>More filters</button>
</div>
<div id="collapse-open-filters" class="hstack flex-wrap gap-8">
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="true">With lunch</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Private</button>
	<button class="chip" type="button" aria-pressed="false">Sunset</button>
</div>

Keyboard and accessibility

KeyOn the button
Enter, SpaceOpens or closes the region; every button for it says the new state
  • Find in page opens a closed region on a match where the browser has hidden="until-found" — Chrome, Firefox 148 and Safari 26.2 on — and the library marks its buttons open; in older browsers the region stays closed until its button opens it.
  • Put the region right after its button in the reading order, or name it, so a reader who opens it finds it.
  • From script: region.hidden = false opens it — set aria-expanded on its buttons yourself then.
